entities.summary: Haitian Revolution, a transformative movement in Grenada (1795–1796). Emerged from Fédon captures most of Grenada and executes British hostages and Julien Fédon launches rebellion — March 2, 1795. Catalyzed Emancipation of enslaved people in Grenada 1834.
